name: All Revved Up NY - Meat Loaf tribute shows
attribution: Some listings come from All Revved Up NY. We write our own short summaries and link back to the original page.
description: Live music listings in Oakdale and Port Jefferson Station: Meat Loaf tribute, classic rock tribute.
reviewNotes: Switched back on 2026-10-06 (issue #40), read on Sundays. Its two Long Island venues (CM Performing Arts Center in Oakdale and Lucky Strike Bar & Lounge in Port Jefferson Station) already had researched venue files; the real problem was that its show list gives the town first and the venue on a later line, so the reader saw only the town. The reader now uses a researched venue named on a later line, in the same town. A new Long Island venue on its list will show up in the run report as a venue to research. Catalog check 2026-10-03: Keep at low priority for live-music cross-checking; it is mostly a listening tribute act (theater dates), but bar and party dates draw dancers.
